product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform combining LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to help enterprises build workforce capability at scale.

pricing_page.notes: The public page is titled Plans and Pricing and lists plans, including a per-learner starting price.

named_customers.notes: The company homepage explicitly says these companies trust Disprz.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies West Orange, New Jersey as company headquarters; Disprz separately labels Chennai its Corporate & Technology HQ.

founded_year.notes: The funding announcement identifies Disprz as established in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is predominantly product, learning-industry, and marketing content; technical-sounding examples are by Product/Content Marketing authors, not engineers, and the evidence does not meet the two-engineer-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: Disprz has a public developer portal and an external API guide covering multiple API categories.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active careers posting is titled AI Content Operations Intern and describes work supporting AI-generated content.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft's Disprz feature says Azure OpenAI is used to drive personalization.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Vault names these; GDPR is described as a privacy-framework compliance, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: The company's funding announcement states it raised $30 million in its Series C round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the August 2023 Series C, before the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listing includes an open role titled AD - Sales (Philippines).

launched_6mo.notes: Disprz announced the Autonomous Enablement OS on 2026-09-28, within six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile says Anand Venkatesan has been Head of Engineering at Disprz since March 2026 and identifies him as Senior Vice President & Head of Engineering, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The job description identifies HubSpot as its CRM and includes Avoma in the GTM/operational technology stack.
